en.title: 7 Shows That Nail the 'Young Sherlock' Vibe
en.summary: If Guy Ritchie's stylish take on a young Sherlock Holmes has you hooked, these seven series offer a similar blend of period intrigue, sharp characters, and compelling mysteries.
en.body:
## 1. Sherlock
Benedict Cumberbatch and Martin Freeman redefined the iconic detective duo for the 21st century in this BBC smash hit. It captures the brilliant deductions and eccentricities of Holmes and Watson, updated with modern technology and a lightning-fast pace that would make even the original Holmes's mind race.

## 2. Miss Scarlet and The Duke
Set in Victorian London, this series follows Eliza Scarlet, a woman who defies societal expectations to run her late father's detective agency. The show masterfully blends intriguing mysteries with the simmering, witty tension between Eliza and Inspector William Wellington, a.k.a. "The Duke."

## 3. The Irregulars
This Netflix series offers a darker, supernatural twist on the Holmes universe, focusing on a group of troubled street kids recruited by Dr. Watson to solve crimes for a mysteriously absent Sherlock. It’s a grittier, more character-driven dive into the shadows of Victorian London.

## 4. Peaky Blinders
While not directly Holmes-related, this critically acclaimed series shares *Young Sherlock*'s DNA with its stylish depiction of a morally ambiguous family navigating the treacherous underworld of post-WWI Birmingham. The show is renowned for its sharp dialogue, compelling anti-heroes, and cinematic flair.

## 5. Penny Dreadful
This gothic horror series weaves together literary characters like Frankenstein's monster and Dorian Gray into a lush, atmospheric tapestry set in Victorian London. If you appreciate *Young Sherlock*'s period setting and complex character studies, *Penny Dreadful*'s dark, sophisticated storytelling will captivate you.

## 6. Enola Holmes 2
While a film, its spirit aligns perfectly with what makes *Young Sherlock* so appealing. Millie Bobby Brown returns as Sherlock’s spirited younger sister, tackling a complex case with her signature wit and determination, all set against a vibrant historical backdrop.

## 7. The Young Indiana Jones Chronicles
This series explores the early adventures of the legendary archaeologist, taking viewers across the globe in various time periods. Like *Young Sherlock*, it offers a compelling origin story, blending historical settings with thrilling, character-focused escapades.

Bottom Line: Dive into these series for more sharp minds, captivating mysteries, and unforgettable characters in richly drawn historical settings.

content_raw: These 15 shows like Young Sherlock capture the same mix of period thrills, sharp wit, and morally complex characters, from Peaky Blinders to Penny Dreadful.
